The earlier representative list was sourced from the WALGA directory as at March 2026 and is retained in the before-review snapshot. Current officeholders come from the official Shire roster checked on 20 November 2026.

The 10 April 2026 court correction and signed 16 April notice identify eight elected councillors and two backfill candidates. The full 2025 ballot, unsuccessful nominees, first preferences and preference distributions have not been reconciled.
The court notice names Valerie O'MEARA, whereas the current Council roster uses Val Ross. These source-specific names have not been merged or treated as a verified alias.

Each current representative links to their directly verified individual official Council profile. The official roster publishes term duration labels. Absolute term-expiry dates are not inferred from those duration labels.
Declared scope is this place route, visible implementation date, breadcrumbs, choices and canonical place identity/boundary pins only.
This manifest does not claim a complete civic journey, current source/legal correctness, full biographies or full historical contestant coverage.
Geometry, people, candidate measures and timing received only the actual checks recorded in the linked national report; their missing coverage remains explicit there.

Browser evidence is a shared-renderer smoke review of its recorded fixtures and viewport/device conditions. It does not establish full per-place source, geometry, mobile, accessibility or browser review.
No new Twinkles were authored; grassroots implementation remains open. A structural PASS is not a national completeness claim.
